title: Fare Thee Honey Blues — Mamie Smith & Her Jazz Hounds (1920)
lyrics:
My baby has left me, I don't know what I'll do
Now every day I've been here, it makes me feel so blue
I'm leaving here today, and that is why

I'm leaving town to wear you off my mind
I've been mistreated and I don't mind dying
I'll buy me a ticket as long as my right arm
I'll ride so far you'll think I'm dead and gone

I'll find me a man, just as long as I'm home
If you don't want me, why don't you tell me so

I can get a friend most anywhere I go
There's a place in Georgia, a change is in the middle of me
I don't want nobody that don't want me
Don't you leave me here

treatment.title_treatment: I want this farewell to feel like a hand-tinted railway melodrama: an abandoned room, a suitcase, and a woman turning hurt into forward motion while the jazz keeps its shoulders up. We move from tobacco amber into rain-blue distance on grainy 35mm, keeping the farewell dignified, the camera curious, and the final empty platform unresolved.

cues.anchor: Bar 1 instrumental opening
cues.cue: Bar 1 opening — establish the deserted room for 8 bars; pre-roll this image through the opening lead-in.
cues.shot: A fictional woman in a modest 1920s traveling coat stands beside two chairs, one conspicuously empty, in a rented room. Slowly dolly inward from the doorway under tobacco-amber window light, hand-tinted 35mm grain, wide framing, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 2 loudness lift from 0.14 to 0.38
cues.cue: Bar 2 lift — breathe warm light once per beat for 4 bars, softly enough to preserve the room's shadows.

cues.anchor: Bar 9 instrumental opening
cues.cue: Bar 9 — track past the waiting suitcase for 5 bars, letting the empty chair stay in the background.
cues.shot: An open leather suitcase rests on a narrow bed while gloved hands fold a plain scarf into it, an empty chair visible beyond. Track sideways at waist height through muted amber light, softly scratched hand-tinted 35mm, no faces close-up or readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 14 first vocal entrance
cues.cue: Bar 14 first vocal entrance — hold her against the empty room for 8 bars, with no sentimental close-up.
cues.shot: The fictional traveler sits in profile at a small table, a second untouched cup across from her, then rises without taking it. Make a restrained semicircular dolly in a medium-wide composition, cool window light against amber plaster, textured 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 14 landing of 'My baby has left me, I don't know what I'll do'
cues.cue: Bar 14, first line landing — burn in the admission for 3.5 bars, small and steady.
cues.lines: My baby has left me, I don't know what I'll do

cues.anchor: Bar 18 landing of 'Now every day I've been here, it makes me feel so blue'
cues.cue: Bar 18, the blue line — let the words emerge quietly for 3.5 bars.
cues.lines: Now every day I've been here, it makes me feel so blue

cues.anchor: Bar 18 loudness lift from 0.20 to 0.51
cues.cue: Bar 18 lift — bring a rain-blue wash across the window side for 4 bars.

cues.anchor: Bar 22 landing of 'I'm leaving here today, and that is why'
cues.cue: Bar 22, leaving today — follow her out of the room and down the boarding-house stairs for 8 bars.
cues.shot: The traveler closes her suitcase and descends a worn boarding-house staircase without looking back, her coat hem swinging with a measured stride. Follow from behind with a gentle descending crane move, amber practical light yielding to blue daylight, hand-tinted 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 22 landing of 'I'm leaving here today, and that is why'
cues.cue: Bar 22, leaving today — type the decision into place and hold for 3 bars.
cues.lines: I'm leaving here today, and that is why

cues.anchor: Bar 26 landing of 'I'm leaving town to wear you off my mind'
cues.cue: Bar 26, leaving town — burn in the line for 3.5 bars as her stride settles.
cues.lines: I'm leaving town to wear you off my mind

cues.anchor: Bar 30 approach to the mistreatment line
cues.cue: Bar 30 — track her toward the ticket counter for 8 bars; play the hurt as resolve, not collapse.
cues.shot: The traveler crosses a cavernous railway waiting room and places coins on a wooden ticket counter, filmed from behind at medium-wide distance. Track parallel to her purposeful walk through blue shadows and a narrow cream skylight, period 35mm grain, no readable signs or text.

cues.anchor: Bar 30 landing of 'I've been mistreated and I don't mind dying'
cues.cue: Bar 30, mistreated — hold the exact line for 3 bars without a lighting accent.
cues.lines: I've been mistreated and I don't mind dying

cues.anchor: Bar 34 landing of 'I'll buy me a ticket as long as my right arm'
cues.cue: Bar 34, the ticket line — type it across the lower frame and hold for 4 bars.
cues.lines: I'll buy me a ticket as long as my right arm

cues.anchor: Bar 38 instrumental space before the long-ride line
cues.cue: Bar 38 — move alongside the carriage for 8 bars, finding her behind a rain-streaked window.
cues.shot: A steam train waits beside a wet platform; the traveler appears seated behind a rain-streaked carriage window with her suitcase on the rack. Dolly along the carriage until her medium-wide silhouette is framed, amber interior against blue steam, hand-tinted 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 43 landing of 'I'll ride so far you'll think I'm dead and gone'
cues.cue: Bar 43, ride so far — burn in the line for 4 bars as the platform begins to slip away.
cues.lines: I'll ride so far you'll think I'm dead and gone

cues.anchor: Bar 44 loudness rise from 0.45 to 0.63
cues.cue: Bar 44 crest — give one broad cream flash on the downbeat, like the train clearing the station roof.

cues.anchor: Bar 46 continuation after the long-ride line
cues.cue: Bar 46 — ride beside her for 8 bars while telegraph poles and fields pass beyond the glass.
cues.shot: Inside a moving wooden railway carriage, the traveler sits upright beside an empty seat while open fields and telegraph poles slide past. Slowly pull back along the aisle under intermittent warm daylight and cool reflected glass, softly worn 35mm, no facial close-ups or readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 52 landing of 'I'll find me a man, just as long as I'm home'
cues.cue: Bar 52, finding someone — let the line arrive quietly for 3.5 bars, without promising a happy ending.
cues.lines: I'll find me a man, just as long as I'm home

cues.anchor: Bar 54 rise toward bar 55 loudness of 0.58
cues.cue: Bar 54 rise — orbit the empty seat opposite her for 8 bars, making absence the scene partner.
cues.shot: The traveler straightens her gloves while looking across at an empty upholstered railway seat, her reflection faint in the window rather than isolated in close-up. Make a slow medium-wide orbit through warm afternoon shafts and deep blue shadows, hand-tinted 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 57 nearest downbeat to 'If you don't want me, why don't you tell me so'
cues.cue: Bar 57, the unanswered question — burn in the line for 4 bars over the empty seat.
cues.lines: If you don't want me, why don't you tell me so

cues.anchor: Bar 62 recovery from bar 61 loudness dip
cues.cue: Bar 62 recovery — bring a small carriage gathering into view for 8 bars, offering company rather than romance.
cues.shot: Several fictional adult passengers in modest period clothes share a bench and make space as the traveler approaches carrying her suitcase. Track backward down the carriage aisle in a welcoming medium-wide tableau, honey-colored window light, textured hand-tinted 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 65 landing of 'I can get a friend most anywhere I go'
cues.cue: Bar 65, a friend anywhere — give the words a firm entrance and hold for 3 bars.
cues.lines: I can get a friend most anywhere I go

cues.anchor: Bar 67 loudness crest of 0.63
cues.cue: Bar 67 crest — lift the amber wash for 1 bar, letting her confidence briefly fill the carriage.

cues.anchor: Bar 68 loudness drop from 0.63 to 0.24
cues.cue: Bar 68 drop — replace the warmth with a low blue wash for 1 bar, keeping the passengers visible.

cues.anchor: Bar 69 landing of 'There's a place in Georgia, a change is in the middle of me'
cues.cue: Bar 69, Georgia — burn in the pasted line unchanged for 4 bars as the landscape opens.
cues.lines: There's a place in Georgia, a change is in the middle of me

cues.anchor: Bar 70 following the Georgia line entrance
cues.cue: Bar 70 — reveal a small rural platform for 8 bars; she steps down with her own suitcase.
cues.shot: At a modest rural railway stop bordered by red earth and dark pines, the traveler descends from a stationary carriage and pauses beneath the canopy. Crane gently outward from a medium-wide view into open space, late amber light with blue platform shadows, hand-tinted 35mm, no readable station signs or text.

cues.anchor: Bar 73 landing of 'I don't want nobody that don't want me'
cues.cue: Bar 73, don't want me — slam the refusal into place for 2 bars, clean and unornamented.
cues.lines: I don't want nobody that don't want me

cues.anchor: Bar 75 landing of 'Don't you leave me here'
cues.cue: Bar 75, the final plea — whisper the words for 3 bars, letting vulnerability interrupt the defiance.

cues.anchor: Bar 78 loudness lift from 0.27 to 0.55
cues.cue: Bar 78 lift — track her one last time for 2 bars as she walks beyond the platform canopy.
cues.shot: The traveler walks away from the camera beyond a rural platform canopy, suitcase held firmly, coat lifting slightly in the breeze. Track forward only a few feet before letting her gain distance, cream rim light and deep tobacco shadows, grainy 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 80 loudness collapse from 0.43 to 0.06
cues.cue: Bar 80 collapse — hold the empty platform for the final 5 bars and carry the image through the recording's end.
cues.shot: An empty rural railway platform remains after the traveler has walked out of frame, a little steam drifting across the distant tracks. Hold a locked wide composition with a barely perceptible retreat, fading blue dusk and one amber lamp, softly scratched 35mm, no readable text.

cues.anchor: Bar 80 start of the low-loudness tail
cues.cue: Bar 80 quiet tail — settle into a dim blue wash for 4 bars; keep the distant amber lamp alive.

cues.anchor: Bar 84 final loudness rise from 0.07 to 0.19
cues.cue: Bar 84 final rise — gently restore the lamp's amber for the last bar, without resolving the empty frame.
